title: circle pack layout strategy
explanation:
### Description

Demonstrate vtkCirclePackLayout with front chain strategy on a flat tree.

**dataset → input → filter → layout → filter → visual_asset → renderer → infrastructure → output**

- [vtkActor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkActor.html) — assigns the mapped geometry to the scene.
- [vtkCirclePackFrontChainLayoutStrategy](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkCirclePackFrontChainLayoutStrategy.html) — circle pack front chain layout strategy.
- [vtkCirclePackLayout](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkCirclePackLayout.html) — circle pack layout.
- [vtkCirclePackToPolyData](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkCirclePackToPolyData.html) — circle pack to poly data.
- [vtkIntArray](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkIntArray.html) — int array.
- [vtkMutableDirectedGraph](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkMutableDirectedGraph.html) — mutable directed graph.
- [vtkPolyDataMapper](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPolyDataMapper.html) — maps polygonal data to graphics primitives.
- [vtkTree](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkTree.html) — tree.
- [vtkTreeFieldAggregator](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkTreeFieldAggregator.html) — tree field aggregator.
- [vtkRenderWindow](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindow.html) — displays the rendered scene in a window on screen.
- [vtkRenderWindowInteractor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindowInteractor.html) — captures mouse and keyboard events.
- [vtkRenderer](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderer.html) — assembles the scene and configures the camera.
- `Initialize()` and `Start()` launch the interactive visualization — `Initialize()` prepares the interactor and `Start()` begins the event loop.
